label: gates held to a schema, #21964 ed120d6d58
why: #21964 holds the security and scope gates' replies to a JSON schema, so the security verdict is only safe and reason. It removes the JSON instructions from both gate prompts, names a form in the scope prompt's in-scope rule, and drops the expected action from five Gates/security items. The gate eval now calls both gates through LLMClient with the schema, as production does. It ran security_check v6 and scope_check v6 under the experiment label. The assistant container for the e2e builds was rebuilt from ed120d6d58, so the builds ran the new gate code. Full check with e2e, with PREVIEW_CHECK_ENABLED off as in production. All four builds finished with success. Every scored behavior has the same score as the #21961 baseline or a higher one. scope.declines-in-users-language is back at 1.0 from 0.867, which the #21961 note put down to run-to-run variation. Studio's preview did not load the app, so build.pages-render and build.entry-page-renders have no score and the run is adopted with --force. The judge is gpt-6.1-sol.
